==Dialogue==
:'''Muxia:''' This feels amazing. I could just hold it in my arms while I sleep tonight.

:{{DIcon}} Are you here to pick up weapons?

:'''Muxia:''' That's right. Master [[Leitao]] works fast and makes quality products. Lots of my colleagues come here when their weapons break.

:'''Muxia:''' peaking of which, you should've already met his [[Leijia|daughter]], right?

:{{DIcon}} I have.

::'''Muxia:''' Quite the personality, doesn't she? The other day, I saw Master Leitao calling her over for dinner.

:{{DIcon}} I haven't.

::'''Muxia:''' Oh, then you should keep a lookout for a giant mechanical bird. Maybe bring her some fun little Automatons sometime.
{{Dialogue End}}
